name: pancake_search_conversations
description: Search or list conversations either in the local database (by query, tag, connectorKey) or directly from the Pancake v2 API (INBOX/COMMENT, unread_first, tags). Read-only.

source.description: Search in local 'db' (/api/admin/conversations) or direct 'provider' (Pancake v2 API). Default: 'db'

q.description: Search query (customer name, phone, or conversation ID) when source='db'

tag.description: Filter by conversation tag (e.g. 'Doanh nghiệp', 'QR Zalo', 'Cá nhân')

lookbackDays.description: Lookback window in days when source='provider' (default: 7)
